_about: Review record for the 20 drawings supplied in September 2026 (docs/portfolio-review.md §3). Not imported by the site. scripts/prepare-incoming.mjs reads it: only status 'approved' produces a public asset in media/artwork/; every record gets a private preview in portfolio-incoming/review/. Working titles are internal until workingTitleApproved is true. Unknown facts stay null and are never rendered.

statuses.approved: Cleared for publication; has a media/artwork/ asset and a content.js entry
statuses.draft: Candidate or hold; private preview only
statuses.archive: Source or alternate capture of another record; keep privately, never publish
